## Why

Post-merge verification (D4-verify-merged-2026-09-20T20) found that #680 lacks the deliberate-break evidence required by #668 acceptance criteria.

## Scope

Capture break/revert evidence for the validation guards in `src/lms/evidence/repository.py` using targeted tests in `tests/evidence/test_evidence_records.py`.

## Non-Goals

_Not provided._

## Tasks

- [ ] Test a temporary validation-guard removal in `src/lms/evidence/repository.py`, record targeted test failure, and restore the guard.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Targeted tests in `tests/evidence/test_evidence_records.py` fail when a validation guard is deliberately removed and pass after restoration.

## Implementation Notes

Implementation paths: `src/lms/evidence/repository.py`, `tests/evidence/test_evidence_records.py`. Record the fail→restore cycle consistent with #667/#671–#673. Relates to #668.

## Why

Post-merge verification (D4-verify-merged-2026-09-20T20) read the squash diff for #680 against #668 acceptance criteria. Domain validation for `create_evidence_record` is present in `src/lms/evidence/repository.py` with substantive parametrized rejection tests in `tests/evidence/test_evidence_records.py`, and Gate passed on merge.

## Unmet criterion

Issue #668 requires that deliberately breaking the validation logic causes the targeted tests to fail. The merged PR body records pytest and lint success but contains no executed break/revert evidence (no deliberate-break marker or logged fail→restore cycle).

## Evidence

- Merged commit: PR #680 (merged 2026-09-19T19:27:28Z)
- Implementation paths: `src/lms/evidence/repository.py`, `tests/evidence/test_evidence_records.py`
- Missing: recorded deliberate-break demonstration per #668 acceptance criteria

## Task

Capture the required break/revert evidence for the validation guards (e.g. temporarily remove a guard and show targeted tests fail), consistent with sibling issues #667/#671–#673 in the same audit batch.

Relates to #668
